'''Bongu''' is a [[Madang language]] spoken in [[Madang Province]], [[Papua New Guinea]].

==Examples of words==
===Russian loan words===
Unlike other indigenous languages of [[Oceania]], the Bongu language has several [[loan word]]s from [[Russian language|Russian]].<ref>{{cite web | url=https://mikluho-maclay.ru/en/russian-loan-words-in-the-indigenous-languages-of-papua-new-guinea/ | title=Russian Loan Words in the Indigenous Languages of Papua New Guinea }}</ref>
